name: ez bar russian twist sit up
description: A sit-up that adds a twist while holding an EZ bar. Works the abs and obliques together.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold the EZ bar over your chest.
Curl up into a sit-up position.
At the top, rotate your torso to one side, moving the bar with you.
Rotate back to center and lower yourself with control.
Keep the weight light enough to move smoothly.
